name: Corn Chowder 3
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: 1 1/2-inch cube fat salt pork or butter
ingredients.originalText: 1 1/2-inch cube fat salt pork or butter

instructions.text: Try out pork, add onion and cook, stirring often that onion may not burn
Parboil potatoes 5 minutes in boiling water to cover, drain and add to onion and strained fat, then add 2 cups boiling water
Cook till potatoes are soft, add corn and milk, and heat to boiling point
Season with salt and pepper, add butter and crackers split and soaked in enough cold milk to moisten
Remove crackers, turn chowder into a tureen and put crackers on top

source.originalInstructions:
1. Try out pork, add onion and cook, stirring often that onion may not burn
2. Parboil potatoes 5 minutes in boiling water to cover, drain and add to onion and strained fat, then add 2 cups boiling water
3. Cook till potatoes are soft, add corn and milk, and heat to boiling point
4. Season with salt and pepper, add butter and crackers split and soaked in enough cold milk to moisten
5. Remove crackers, turn chowder into a tureen and put crackers on top
